scope: research-only lossless FP32 block storage and fused GEMV; no runtime replacement
storage: 23 fraction bits + sign + per-block exponent delta; packed 24..32-bit integer words, 64-bit header per 256 values, one guard word
fixed28_policy: 28-bit sign/fraction/exponent-delta blocks; blocks whose exponent span exceeds 16 use verbatim FP32
timing_scope: warm amortized CUDA graphs and 128 MiB-evicted replay; packing, copies and capture excluded; decoded/full FP32 weights kept only as reference controls
